G4200.def:
πορισμός, -ου, ὁ
(πορίζω, to procure), [in LXX: Wis.13:19 14:2 * ;]
__1. a providing.
__2. a means of gain: 1Tm 6:5-6 (Polyb., al.).†
(AS)

G4201.def:
Πόρκιος, -ου, ὁ
Porcius, prænomen of Porcius Festus (see: Φῆστος): At 24:27.†
(AS)

G4202.def:
πορνεία, -ας, ἡ
(πορνεύω), [in LXX for תַּזְנוּת and cogn. forms ;]
fornication: At 15:20, 29 21:25, 1Co 5:1 6:13 6:18, 2Co 12:21, Gl 5:19, Ef 5:3, Cl 3:5, 1Ts 4:3 (Lft., Notes, 53), Ap 9:21; pl. (see WM, 220; Bl., § 32, 6), 1Co 7:2; disting. from μοιχεία, Mt 15:19, Mc 7:21; = μοιχεία (Amos 8:17 Sir.23:23, al.), Mt 5:32 19:9. Metaphorical (of idolatry: Dt 23:2, Os 1:2): Jo 8:41 (Westc., in l), and so perh. (Thayer-Grimm, see word; but see Swete, in 11.), Ap 2:21 14:18 17:2, 4 18:3 19:2.†
(AS)

G4203.def:
πορνεύω
[in LXX for זָנָה ;]
__1. to prostitute the body for hire.
__2. to commit fornication: Mc 10:19 (WH, mg), 1Co 6:18 10:8, Ap 2:14, 20. Metaphorical (as in LXX: 1Cr 5:25, Jr 3:6, Os 9:1, al.), of idolatry (but see Swete, Ap., 180 f.), Ap 17:2 18:3, 9 (cf. ἐκ- πορνεύω).†
(AS)

G4204.def:
πόρνη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for זָנָה ;]
a prostitute, harlot: Mt 21:31-32, Lc 15:30, 1Co 6:15-16 Hb 11:31, Tg 2:25. Metaphorical (see Swete, Ap., 180 f.), of Babylon (i.e. Rome): Ap 17:1, 5 17:15-16 19:2.†
(AS)

G4205.def:
πόρνος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: Sir.23:16-18 * ;]
__1. a male prostitute (Xen., al.).
__2. a fornicator: 1Co 5:9-11 6:9, Ef 5:5, 1Tm 1:10, Hb 12:15 13:4, Ap 21:8 22:15.†
(AS)

G4206.def:
πόρρω
adv. (in older Attic, πρόσω), [in LXX for רָחוֹק, etc. ;]
far off: Mt 15:8, Mc 7:6" (LXX), Lc 14:32; comparat., πορρώτερον (-ρω, T), Lc 24:28.†
(AS)

G4207.def:
πόρρωθεν
adv. (τόρρω, which see), [in LXX for רָחוֹק and cogn. forms ;]
from afar: Lc 17:12, Hb 11:13.†
(AS)

G4209.def:
πορφύρα, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX for אַרְגָּמָן, אַרְגְּוָן ;]
__1. the purple fish (cf. 1Ma.4:23).
__2. purple dye.
__3. Later, = πορφυρίς, a purple gar­ment: Mc 15:17, 20, Lc 16:19, Ap 18:12.†
(AS)

G4210.def:
πορφύρεος, -α, -ον contr., -οῦς, -ᾶ, -οῦν
(ποπφύρα), [in LXX for אַרְגָּמָן ;]
purple: Jo 19:2, 5; as subst., πορφυροῦν (sc. ἱμάτιον), Ap 17:4 18:6.†
(AS)

G4211.def:
πορφυρόπωλις, -ιδος, ἡ
a seller of purple fabrics: At 16:14.†
(AS)

G4212.def:
ποσάκις
interrog. num. adv.,
how often: Mt 18:21 23:37, Lc 13:34.†
(AS)

G4213.def:
πόσις, -εως, ἡ
(πίνω), [in LXX: Da, LXX TH Dn 1:10 (מִשְׁתֶּה) * ;]
__1. prop., drinking: Rm 14:17, Cl 2:16 (see Lft.; ICC, in l).
__2. = πόμα, drink: Jo 6:55 (cf. βρῶσις).†
(AS)

G4214.def:
πόσος, -η, -ον
adj. of number, magnitude, degree, etc.,
how much, how great, how many: Mt 6:23, 2Co 7:11; of time, Mc 9:21; neut., absol., Lc 16:5, 7; dative, πόσῳ, adverbially, how much, Mt 12:12; id. before μᾶλλον, Mt 7:11 10:25, Lc 11:13 12:24, 28, Rm 11:12, 24, Phm 16, Hb 9:14; π. χείρονος τιμωρίας, Hb 10:29; pl., Mt 15:34 16:9-10 27:13, Mc 6:38 8:5, 19-20 15:4, Lc 15:17, At 21:20.†
(AS)

G4215.def:
ποταμός, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for נָהָר, יְאֹר ;]
a river, stream, torrent: Mt 3:5 7:25, 27, Mc 1:1-45 :, Lc 6:48-49, At 16:13, 2Co 11:26, Ap 8:10 9:14 12:15-16 16:4, 12 21:1-2. Fig., pl., π. ὕδατος ζῶντος, Jo 7:38.†
(AS)

G4216.def:
ποταμο-φόρητος, -ον
carried away by a stream:
Ap 12:15 (for two exx. in π., see MM, xxi).†
(AS)

G4217.def:
ποταπός
(late form of cl. ποδ-), -ή, -όν, [in LXX: Dan LXX Su 1:54* ;]
__1. (= ποδαπός) from what country?
__2. In late writers, = ποῖος, of what sort?: Mt 8:27, Mc 13:1, Lc 1:29 7:39, 2Pe 3:11, 1Jo 3:1.†
(AS)

G4218.def:
ποτέ
enclitic particle,
__1. once, formerly, sometime: of the past, Jo 9:13 Rm 7:9 11:30, Gl 1:13, 23 2:6 (Lft., in l), Ef 2:2-3, 11 2:13 5:8, Cl 1:21 3:7, 1Ts 2:5, Tt 3:3, Phm 11, 1Pe 2:10 3:5 3:20; ἤδη ποτέ, now at length, Fp 4:10; of the fut., Lc 22:32; εἴ πως ἤδη ποτέ, if sometime soon at length, Rm 1:10.
__2. ever: after a neg., Ef 5:29, 2Pe 1:10 1:21; in a question, τίς π., 1Co 9:7, Hb 1:5, 13.†
(AS)

G4219.def:
πότε
interrog. adv. of time,
when?: Mt 25:37-39, 44 Lc 21:7, Jo 6:25; ἕως π., how long: Mt 17:17, Mc 9:19, Lc 9:41, Jo 10:24, Ap 6:10. In indir. questions, = ὁπότε, Mt 24:3, Mc 13:4, 33 13:35, Lc 12:36 17:20 (see Bl., § 25, 4).†
(AS)

G4220.def:
πότερος, -α, -ον
which of two. Neut., adverbially, πότερον, whether: Jo 7:17.†
(AS)

G4221.def:
ποτήριον, -ου, τό dimin. of ποτήρ
(πίνω), [in LXX chiefly for כּוֹס:]
a wine cup: Mt 23:25-26 26:27, Mc 7:4 14:23, Lc 11:39 22:17, 20 a (WH, R, mg., cm.), 1Co 11:25, Ap 17:4; πίνειν ἐκ τοῦ π., 1Co 11:28; with genitive of thing(s), Mt 10:42, Mc 9:41; τ. εὐλογίας, 1Co 10:16; by meton., of the contents of the cup, Lc 22:20 b (WH, R, mg., cm.), 1Co 11:25-26; with genitive of person(s), 1Co 10:21 11:27. Metaphorical, of experience of divine providence; of prosperity (Sl 16:5, al.); of adversity (Sl 11:6, Is 51:17, al.): of the sufferings of Christ, Mt 20:22-23 26:39 10:38-39 14:36, Lc 22:42, Jo 18:11; of divine punishment, Ap 14:10 16:19 18:6.†
(AS)

G4222.def:
ποτίζω
(πότος), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁקָה hi. ;]
to give to drink: with accusative of person(s), Mt 25:35, 37 25:42 27:48, Mc 15:36, Lc 13:15, Rm 12:20; with dupl. accusative, Mt 10:42, Mc 9:41; fig., γάλα, 1Co 3:2; ἐκ τ. οἴνου Ap 14:8; of plants, to water (Xen., Strab., al.; Gn 13:10), figuratively, 1Co 3:6-8 Metaphorical (cf. Is 29:10 Sir.15:3), of the Spirit, 1Co 12:13.†
(AS)

G4223.def:
Ποτίολοι, -ων, οἱ
Puteoli (mod. Pozzuoli), a city on the Bay of Naples: At 28:13.†
(AS)

G4224.def:
πότος, -ου, ὁ
(πίνω), [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁתֶּה ;]
a drinking bout, carousal: 1Pe 4:3.†
SYN.: see: κραιπάλη (AS)

G4225.def:
πού
enclitic particle,
__1. anywhere, somewhere: Hb 2:6 4:4.
__2. in some degree, perhaps, about: At 27:29 (T, μήπου), Rm 4:19; δή που (T, δήπου), surely: Hb 2:16.†
(AS)

G4226.def:
ποῦ
interrog. adv., [in LXX for אַי, אַיֵּה, אָן ;]
__1. prop., where?: Mt 2:2 26:17, Mc 14:12, 14, Lc 17:17, 37 22:9, 11, Jo 1:39 7:11 8:10, 19 9:12 11:34; ποῦ (ἐστιν), indicating that the subject in question is not to be found, Lc 8:25, Rm 3:27, 1Co 1:20 12:17 12:19 15:55, Gl 4:15, 2Pe 3:4; ποῦ φανεῖται, 1Pe 4:18.
__2. = ὅπου (WM, 640; B1., § 50, 5): with indic., Mt 2:4, Mc 15:47, Jo 1:40 11:57 20:2, 13 20:15 Ap 2:13; with subjc., Mt 8:20, Lc 9:58 12:17.
__3. In colloq. (as in Eng.) = ποῖ, whither: in direct questions, Jo 7:35 9:12 13:36 16:5; in indir. quest., Jo 3:8 8:14 12:35 14:5, Hb 11:8, 1Jo 2:11.†
(AS)

G4227.def:
Πούδης
(in π., genitive -εντος, see Zorell, see word), ὁ (Latin)
Pudens: 2Tm 4:21.†
(AS)

G4228.def:
πούς, ποδός, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for רֶגֶל ;]
a foot, both of men and beasts: Mt 4:6 (LXX), Mc 9:45, Lc 1:79, Jo 11:44, At 7:5, al.; ὑπο τοὺς π., Rm 16:20, 1Co 15:25 15:27 Ef 1:22, Hb 2:8; ὑποκάτω τῶν π., Mt 22:44 (LXX); πρὸς (παρὰ) τοὺς π., Mc 5:22, Lc 8:41, al.; figuratively, Mt 15:30, Lc 10:39, At 5:2, al.; ἔμπροσθεν τῶν π., Ap 3:9 19:10, al.; ἐπὶ τοὺς π., At 10:25. By meton., of a person in motion (Sl 119:101): Lc 1:79, At 5:9, Rm 3:15 10:15, Hb 12:13
(AS)

G4229.def:
πρᾶγμα, -τος, τύ
(πράσσω), [in LXX chiefly for דָּבָר ;]
__1. that which has been done, a deed, act: Lc 1:1, At 5:4, 2Co 7:11, Hb 6:18.
__2. That which is being done (like Lat. res), hence, a thing, matter, affair: Mt 18:19, Rm 16:2, 1Ts 4:6 (see M, Th., in l), Hb 10:1 11:1, Tg 3:16; in forensic sense (as frequently in π., see Deiss., BS, 233), a law-suit: 1Co 6:1.†
(AS)

G4230.def:
πραγματία (Rec. -εία, as in cl.), -ας, ἡ
(πραγματεύομαι) [in LXX for חֲשַׁל, etc. ;]
__1. careful application, hard work.
__2. business, occupation: pl., 2Tm 2:4.†
(AS)

G4231.def:
πραγματεύομαι
(πρᾶγμα), [in LXX: 3Ki.10:22 B, 3Ki.9:19 A (חָשַׁק), Dan LXX 8:27 (מְלָאכָה ־אֵת עָשָׂה) * ;]
__1. to busy oneself.
__2. to be engaged in business, esp. to trade: Lc 19:13 (cf. δια-πραγματεύομαι).†
(AS)

G4232.def:
πραιτώριον, -ου, τό (Lat. prætorium)
__1. headquarters in a Roman camp,
__2. The palace or official residence of the Governor of a province: Mt 27:27, Mc 15:16 (see Swete, in l), Jo 18:28, 33 19:9; τ. π. τ. Ἡρώδου, At 23:35.
__3. the Prætorian Guard: Fp 1:13 (see Lft., in l; ICC, 51 f.).†
(AS)

G4233.def:
πράκτωρ, -ορος, ὁ
(πράσσω), [in LXX: Is 3:12 (נָגַשׁ) * ;]
__1. (poët.) one who does or accomplishes.
__2. In Athens, one who exacts payment, a collector; hence, generally (frequently in π., see Deiss., BS, 154), a court officer: Lc 12:58.†
(AS)

G4234.def:
πρᾶξις, -εως, ἡ
(πράσσω), [in LXX: 2Cr 13:22 27:7 28:26 (דֶּרֶךְ), Jó 24:5 A (פֹּעַל), Pv 13:13, Wis.9:11, al. ;]
__1. a doing, deed, act: Mt 16:27; pl., π. ἀποσπτόλων, Ac, title; in late writers especially of wicked deeds or practices (frequently in Polyb.): Lc 23:51; p1., Rm 8:13, Cl 3:9; with ref. to magic (see BS, 3235), At 19:18.
__2. an acting, action, business, function: Rm 12:4.†
(AS)

G4235.def:
πρᾷος, πρᾶος, see: πραΰς.
πραΰς, -εῖα, -ΰ, and πρᾷος
(Or πρᾶος, ν. Bl., § 3, 3), -α, -ον (see LS, Thayer, see word), [in LXX (always -ΰς, exc. 2Ma.15:12, -ᾷος, see Thackeray, Gr., 180 f.) for עָנָו, עָנִי ;]
gentle, meek: Mt 5:5 11:29 21:5" (LXX) 1Pe 3:4.†
(AS)

G4236.def:
πρᾳότης, πραότης, see: πραΰτης.
πραΰτης
(Rec. -ότης, exc. Ja, 1Pe, ll. with, where πρᾳύτης), -ητος, ἡ, late form of πραότης, [in LXX: Sl 45:4 90:10 132:1 (עַנְוָה, עֱנוּת, Et 5:1, Sir.6:1-37 * ;]
gentleness, meekness: 1Co 4:21, 2Co 10:1, Gl 5:23 6:1, Ef 4:2, Cl 3:12 (see Lft., in l), 2Ti_2:25, Tt 3:2, Tg 1:21 3:13, 1Pe 3:15.†
SIN.: ἐπιεικία, q.v
(AS)

G4237.def:
πρασιά, -ᾶς, ἡ
[in LXX: Sir.24:31 * ;]
a garden-bed; metaphorically, of ranks or orderly groups of persons: Mc 6:40.†
(AS)

G4238.def:
πράσσω
(Att.. -ττω, and so At 17:7 Rec.; cf. M, Pr., 25, 45), [in LXX chiefly for עָשָׂה, פָּעַל ;]
= Lat agere, as ποιέω (which see) = facere,
__1. to do, practise, be engaged in: At 19:19, 36, 1Co 9:17; τ. ἴδια π., to mind one's own business (τὰ ἑαυτοῦ, Soph., Plat.), 1Ts 4:11; intrans., to act, At 17:7.
__2. to achieve, effect, accomplish, perform: At 26:20, 26 Rm 7:15 9:11, 2Co 5:10, Fp 4:9; νόμον (ICC, in l), Rm 2:25; of unworthy acts (for WH. usually ποιέω in cl.), to commit, do: Lc 22:23 23:41, Jo 3:20 5:29, At 3:17 5:35 16:28 25:11, 25 26:9, 31, Rm 1:32 (ICC, in l), Rm 2:1-3 7:19 13:4, 1Co 5:2, 2Co 12:21, Gl 5:21.
__3. to transact, manage, hence, of payment, to exact (cl.): Lc 3:13 19:23.
__4. Reflexively, of state or condition, to do or fare Æsch., Hdt., al.): Ef 6:21; εὖ π. (see M, Pr., 228 f.), At 15:29.†
SYN.: see: ποιέω (AS)

G4240.def:
πραΰτης
(Rec. -ότης, exc. Ja, 1Pe, ll. with, where πρᾳύτης), -ητος, ἡ, late form of πραότης, [in LXX: Sl 45:4 90:10 132:1 (עַנְוָה, עֱנוּת, Et 5:1, Sir.6:1-37 * ;]
gentleness, meekness: 1Co 4:21, 2Co 10:1, Gl 5:23 6:1, Ef 4:2, Cl 3:12 (see Lft., in l), 2Ti_2:25, Tt 3:2, Tg 1:21 3:13, 1Pe 3:15.†
SIN.: ἐπιεικία, q.v
(AS)

G4241.def:
πρέπω
[in LXX: Sl 93:5 (נָאָה pi.), etc. ;]
__1. to be clearly seen.
__2. to resemble.
__3. to be fitting or becoming, to suit: with dative, Hb 7:26, 1Tm 2:10, Tt 2:1; impers., with dative, Ef 5:3; id. before inf., Hb 2:10; πρέπον ἐστίν, with dative of person(s) and inf., Mt 3:15; with accusative and inf., 1Co 11:13 (see Bl., § 72, 5).†
(AS)

G4242.def:
πρεσβεία, -ας, ἡ
(πρεσβεύω), [in LXX: 2Ma.4:11 * ;]
__1. age, seniority.
__2. rank, dignity.
__3. an embassy; by meton., of the am­bassadors, embassy: Lc 14:32 19:14.†
(AS)

G4243.def:
πρεσβεύω
(πρέσβυς),
__1. to be the elder, to take precedence.
__2. to be an ambassador (see: πρεσβύτης): 2Co 5:20, Ef 6:20.†
(AS)

G4244.def:
πρεσβυτέριον, -ου, τό
(πρεσβύτερος) [in LXX: Da TH Su 1:50 A * ;]
a body of elders, presbytery: of the Sanhedrin (cf. συνέδριον), Lc 22:66, At 22:5; of Christian presbyters, 1Tm 4:14.†
(AS)

G4245G.def:
πρέσβυς, -εως, ὁ poët. form of πρεσβύτης (which see),
[in LXX (= πρεσβευτής, an ambassador): Nm 21:20 (21), al. (מֲלְאָךְ), Is 13:8 57:9 (צִיר), 1Ma.9:70, al. ;]
an old man.
Compar.,
πρεσβύτερος, -α, -ον,
[in LXX chiefly for זָקֵן ;]
__1. of age, elder: ὁ νἱὸς ὁ π., Lc 15:25; as subst., opposite to νεανίσκοι, At 2:17; to νεώτερος, 1Tm 5:1-2; of the religious leaders of the past, Mt 15:2, Mc 7:3, 5, Hb 11:2 (= οἱ πατέρες, Hb 1:1).
__2. Of dignity, rank or office (as found in π. and Inscr. of civil and religious offices, including priesthood, in Asia Minor and in Egypt; see Deiss., BS, 154 ff., 233 If.; LAE, 373);
__(a) among Jews: Mt 16:21 26:47, 57 27:3, 12 27:20, 41 28:12, Mc 8:31 11:27 14:43, 53 15:1, Lc 7:3 9:22 20:1 22:52, Jo 8:9, At 4:5, 8 4:23 6:12 23:14 24:1; τ. Ἰουνδαίων, At 25:15; τ. λαοῦ, Mt 21:23 26:3 27:1;
__(b) among Christians: At 11:30 14:23 15:2, 4 15:6, 22-23 16:4 21:18, 1Tm 5:17 5:19, Tt 1:5, II Jn 1, 3Jn.1, 1Pe 5:1 5:5; τ. ἐκκλησίας, At 20:17, Tg 5:14;
__(with) in the visions of the Apocalypse: Ap 4:4, 10 5:5-6, 8 5:11, 14 7:11, 13 11:16 14:3 19:4.
(On the NT use of this word and its relation to ἐπίσκοπος (which see), cf. Lft., Phi., 93 ff., 189 ff.; CGT, Past. Epp., lvi ff.) †
(AS)

G4245H.def:
πρέσβυς, -εως, ὁ poët. form of πρεσβύτης (which see),
[in LXX (= πρεσβευτής, an ambassador): Nm 21:20 (21), al. (מֲלְאָךְ), Is 13:8 57:9 (צִיר), 1Ma.9:70, al. ;]
an old man.
Compar.,
πρεσβύτερος, -α, -ον,
[in LXX chiefly for זָקֵן ;]
__1. of age, elder: ὁ νἱὸς ὁ π., Lc 15:25; as subst., opposite to νεανίσκοι, At 2:17; to νεώτερος, 1Tm 5:1-2; of the religious leaders of the past, Mt 15:2, Mc 7:3, 5, Hb 11:2 (= οἱ πατέρες, Hb 1:1).
__2. Of dignity, rank or office (as found in π. and Inscr. of civil and religious offices, including priesthood, in Asia Minor and in Egypt; see Deiss., BS, 154 ff., 233 If.; LAE, 373);
__(a) among Jews: Mt 16:21 26:47, 57 27:3, 12 27:20, 41 28:12, Mc 8:31 11:27 14:43, 53 15:1, Lc 7:3 9:22 20:1 22:52, Jo 8:9, At 4:5, 8 4:23 6:12 23:14 24:1; τ. Ἰουνδαίων, At 25:15; τ. λαοῦ, Mt 21:23 26:3 27:1;
__(b) among Christians: At 11:30 14:23 15:2, 4 15:6, 22-23 16:4 21:18, 1Tm 5:17 5:19, Tt 1:5, II Jn 1, 3Jn.1, 1Pe 5:1 5:5; τ. ἐκκλησίας, At 20:17, Tg 5:14;
__(with) in the visions of the Apocalypse: Ap 4:4, 10 5:5-6, 8 5:11, 14 7:11, 13 11:16 14:3 19:4.
(On the NT use of this word and its relation to ἐπίσκοπος (which see), cf. Lft., Phi., 93 ff., 189 ff.; CGT, Past. Epp., lvi ff.) †
(AS)

G4246.def:
πρεσβύτης, -ου prose form of πρέσβυς, which see,
[in LXX chiefly for זָקֵן, Gn 25:8, al.; also (= πρεσβευτής), 2Cr 32:31 Bl (לוּץ), 1Ma.14:22 S, al. (see Thackeray, Gr., 97) ;]
__1. an old man: Lc 1:18, Tt 2:2, Phm 9 (R, txt., but see infr.).
__2. As in LXX, also = πρεσβευτής, an am­bassador: Phm 9 (R, mg., see Lft. and ICC, in l).†
(AS)

G4247.def:
πρεσβῦτις, -ιδος, ἡ fem, of πρεσβύτης,
[in LXX: 4Ma.16:14 * ;]
an aged woman: Tt 2:3.†
(AS)

G4248.def:
πρηνής, -ές
(in Att.. also πρανής), [in LXX: Wis.4:19, 3Ma.5:43 3Mac 5:50 3Mac 6:23 * ;]
headlong, prone: At 1:18.†
(AS)

G4249.def:
πρίζω = πρίω,
[in LXX: Am 1:3, Da TH Su 1:59 * ;]
to saw, saw asunder (= π. δίχα, Thuc., iv, 100): pass, Hb 11:37 (cf. δια-πρίω).†
(AS)

G4250.def:
πρίν
__1. as adv. of time, before, formerly (cl.; 3Ma.5:28 3Mac 6:4 3Mac 6:31)
__2. As conic. (cl.), before;
__(a) after a positive sentence, with accusative and inf.: Mt 26:34, 75, Mc 14:72, Lc 22:61, Jo 4:49 8:58 (where D. om. γενέσθαι and π. becomes prep. with genitive; see Bl., § 69, 7) Jo 14:29, At 2:20" (LXX), WH, txt.; πρὶν ἤ (not such good Attic in this construction; see Bl., l.with), Mt 1:18 Mc 14:30, At 2:20, WH, mg., At 7:2;
__(b) after a negative sentence, πρὶν ἤ: a. subjc. (before ἄν, M, Pr., 169), Lc 2:26; with optative, At 25:16.†
(AS)

G4251.def:
Πρίσκα, -ας, ἡ (Lat.), and Πρίσκιλλα, -ης, ἡ, Prisca: Rom_16:3, 1Co_16:19, 2Ti_4:19; Priscilla: Act_18:2; Act_18:18; Act_18:26; the wife of Aquila, vs. Ἀκύλας.†
(AS)

G4252.def:
Πρίσκιλλα, see: Πρίσκα.
Πρίσκα, -ας, ἡ (Lat.), and Πρίσκιλλα, -ης, ἡ, Prisca: Rom_16:3, 1Co_16:19, 2Ti_4:19; Priscilla: Act_18:2; Act_18:18; Act_18:26; the wife of Aquila, vs. Ἀκύλας.†
(AS)

G4253.def:
πρό
prep. with genitive, [in LXX chiefly for פָּנִים ;]
before;
__(a) of place: At 12:6, 14 14:13, Tg 5:9; π. προσώπου (= Heb. פָּנִים, Dt 3:18, Ml 3:1, al.; Bl., § 40, 9), Mt 11:10, Mc 1:2, Lc 1:76 7:27 9:52 10:1, At 14:13;
__(b) of time: Mt 8:29 24:38, Lc 11:38 21:12, Jo 11:55 13:1 17:24, At 5:36 21:38, 1Co 2:7 4:5, Ef 1:4, Cl 1:17, 2Tm 1:9 4:21, Tt 1:2, Hb 11:5, 1Pe 1:20, Ju 25; π. ἐτῶν δεκατεσσάρων, fourteen years ago, 2Co 12:2; π. προσώπου (see supr.), At 13:24; with genitive of person(s), Mt 5:12, Jo 5:7 10:8, Rm 16:7, Gl 1:17; with genitive art. inf. (= πρίν; M, Pr., 100; Bl., § 69, 7), Mt 6:8 Lc 2:21 22:15, Jo 1:49 13:19 17:5, At 23:15, Gl 2:12 3:23; as in late writers (resembling a Latin idiom but indepen­dent of it; B1., § 40, 5; M, Pr., 100 f.; of. Am 2Ma.15:36, and for other exx., Soph., Lex., see word), πρὸ ἓξ ἡμέρας τοῦ πάσχα, on the sixth day before the Passover, Jo 12:1;
__(with) of preference: π. πάντων, Tg 5:12, 1Pe 4:8;
__(d) in compos.,
__α with subst., of position before: προαύλιον, πρόδρομος; priority of rank or order, προπάτωρ; anticipation, πρό γνωσις, πρό νοια;
__β with adj., intensity, πρόδηλος;
__γ with verb., of place, προάγω, προβαίνω; of preference, προαιρέομαι.†
(AS)

G4254.def:
προ-άγω
[in LXX: 1Rs 17:16 (נָגַשׁ), Wis.19:11, al. ;]
__1. prop. trans., to lead on, lead forth or forward: with accusative of person(s), At 16:30 17:5; of bringing forth to trial, At 12:6 (WH, txt., προσάγ-); before ἐπί, with genitive of person(s), At 25:26.
__2. Intrans. (Plat., Polyb., and later writers; see Bl., § 53, 1; MM, xxi);
__(a) to lead the way, 1Tm 1:18 (R, mg.), hence, to go before, precede: Lc 18:39; opposite to ἀκολουθέω, Mc 11:9; before εἰς, Mt 14:22, Mc 6:45, 1Tm 5:24, Hb 7:18; with accusative of person(s), Mt 2:9 21:9, Mc 10:32; before εἰς, Mt 21:31 26:32 28:7, Mc 14:28 16:7;
__(b) to go on, advance (Sir.20:27): 2Jn.9.†
(AS)

G4255.def:
προ-αιρέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: for חָשַׁק, etc. ;]
to bring forth or forward. Most frequently in mid., to take by choice, prefer, propose: 2Co 9:7.†
(AS)

G4256.def:
προ-αιτιάομαι, -ῶμαι
to accuse or charge beforehand: Rm 3:9 (not elsewhere) .†
(AS)

G4257.def:
προ-ακούω
to hear beforehand: Cl 1:5 (see Lft., in l).†
(AS)

G4260.def:
προ-βαίνω
[in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;]
to go forwards, go on, advance: Mt 4:21, Mc 1:19. Metaphorical, of age (Gn 18:11, al., Lys., Diod., al.), ἐν τ. ἡμέραις, Lc 1:7, 18 2:36.†
(AS)

G4261.def:
προ-βάλλω
[in LXX for חוּד, מָרַק, etc. ;]
__1. to throw before.
__2. to put forward: with accusative, At 19:33; of trees, to put forth, produce (sc. φύλλα), Lc 21:30.†
(AS)

G4262.def:
προβατικός, -ή, -όν
(πρόβατον) [in LXX (π. πύλη): Ne 3:1, 32 12:39 (צֹאן)* ;]
of sheep: ἡ π. (sc. πύλη, see supr.), the sheep-gate, Jo 5:2.†
(AS)

G4263.def:
πρόβατον, -ου, τό
(προβαίνω), [in LXX chiefly for צֹאן, also for שֶׂה, more rarely for כֶּבֶשׂ (כֶּשֶׂב), רָחֵל ;]
__1. in Hom., Hdt., cattle, esp. of small cattle, sheep and goats.
__2. In NT, as in Attic writers generally (cf. MM, xxi), a sheep: Mt 7:15, Mc 6:34, al.; πρόβατα σφαγῆς, Rm 8:36 (LXX). Metaphorical (in cl. of timidity, stupidity or idleness), of the followers of a leader or master, esp. of those who are subject to the care of the Good Shepherd: Mt 10:6 15:24 26:31" (LXX) Mc 14:27 (LXX), Jo 10:7-8, 15-16 10:26-27 21:16-17 (WH txt., προβάτια), Hb 13:20; opposite to ἐρίφια, Mt 25:33.
προβάτιον, -ου, τό,
dimin. of πρόβατον (used as a term of endearment, see El., § 27, 4), a little sheep: Jo 21:16-17 (πρόβατα, WH, mg.).†
(AS)

G4264.def:
προ-βιβάζω causal of προβαίνω,
[in LXX: Êx 35:34 (יָרָה hi.), Dt 6:7 (שָׁנַן pi.) * ;]
to lead forward, lead on; metaphorically, to induce, incite, urge: Mt 14:8.†
(AS)

G4265.def:
προ-βλέπω
[in LXX: Sl 37:13 (רָאָה)* ;]
to foresee: mid., Hb 11:40 (see Bl., § 24, 55, 1).†
(AS)

G4266.def:
προ-γίνομαι
[in LXX: Wis.19:13 אA, 2Ma.14:3 2Mac 15:8 * ;]
to happen before: pf. pass. ptcp., Rm 3:25.†
(AS)

G4267.def:
προ-γινώσκω
[in LXX: Wis.6:13 8:8 18:6 * ;]
to know beforehand, foreknow: 2Pe 3:17; with accusative of person(s), At 26:5; of the Divine foreknowledge, Rm 8:29 11:2, 1Pe 1:20.†
(AS)

G4269.def:
πρό-γονος, -ον
(προγίνομαι), [in LXX: Et 4:17, Sir.8:4, al. ;]
__1. born before.
__2. As subst., in pl., οἱ π., ancestors, forefathers: 2Tm 1:3; of living parents (so Plat.), 1Tm 5:4.†
(AS)

G4270.def:
προ-γράφω
[in LXX: Dan LXX 3:3 cod., 1Ma.10:36 * ;]
__1. to write before: Rm 15:4, Ef 3:3, Ju 4.
__2. to write in public, placard, proclaim (Dem., Plut., al.): Gl 3:1 (Lft., in l).
__3. = ζωγραφέω, to pourtray, depict: Ga, l.with (Syr. Pesh., Chrys.; Field, Notes, 189; CGT, in l).†
(AS)

G4271.def:
πρό-δηλος, -ον
[in LXX: Jdth.8:29, 2Ma.3:17 2Mac 14:39 * ;]
__1. evident beforehand.
__2. clearly evident: 1Tm 5:24-25 Hb 7:14.†
(AS)

G4272.def:
προ-δίδωμι
[in LXX: Eze.16:34 A (נָתַן), 4Ma.4:1, al. ;]
__1. to give before, give first: Rm 11:35 (Jó 41:2 (11) LXX, al.).
__2. to betray (4Mac, l.with).†
(AS)

G4273.def:
προ-δότης, -ου, ὁ
(προδίδωμι) [in LXX: 2Ma.5:15 2Mac 10:13 2Mac 10:22, 3Ma.3:24 * ;]
a betrayer, traitor: Lc 6:16, At 7:52, 2Tm 3:4.†
(AS)

G4274.def:
πρό-δρομος, -ον
(προτρέχω) [in LXX: Nm 13:21 (20), Is 28:4 (בִּכּוּר), Wis.12:8 * ;]
running forward, going in advance. As subst., ὁ π., an advance guard, forerunner: Hb 6:20.†
(AS)

G4277.def:
προ-εῖπον 2 aor. from unused Pres. (see: εἶπον, and pf., -είρηκα (3Ma.6:35 *), pass., -είρημαι (2Ma.2:32, 3Ma.1:26, al.),
__1. to say before: Gl 1:9, 1Ts 4:6 (on the form -αμεν, see WH, App., 164), Hb 4:7; before ὅτι, 2Co 7:3 13:2, Gl 5:21; of prophecy, Mt 24:25, Mc 13:23, At 1:16, Rm 9:29, 2Pe 3:2, Ju 17.
__2. to proclaim publicly, declare openly or plainly (cl.): so R, mg., in 2Co 13:2, Gl 5:21, 1Ts 4:6 (cf. προλέγω; but see supr., and cf. M, Th., 38).†
(AS)

G4278.def:
προ-ενάρχομαι
to begin before: 2Co 8:6; with accusative, τὸ θέλειν, 2Co 8:10 (not elsewhere).†
(AS)

G4279.def:
προ-επ-αγγέλλω
to announce before. Mid., to promise before: with accusative of thing(s), Rm 1:2, 2Co 9:5 (Dio. Cass.).†
(AS)

G4280.def:
προ-ερέω, -ῶ, see: προεῖπον.
προ-εῖπον 2 aor. from unused Pres. (see: εἶπον, and pf., -είρηκα (3Ma.6:35 *), pass., -είρημαι (2Ma.2:32, 3Ma.1:26, al.),
__1. to say before: Gl 1:9, 1Ts 4:6 (on the form -αμεν, see WH, App., 164), Hb 4:7; before ὅτι, 2Co 7:3 13:2, Gl 5:21; of prophecy, Mt 24:25, Mc 13:23, At 1:16, Rm 9:29, 2Pe 3:2, Ju 17.
__2. to proclaim publicly, declare openly or plainly (cl.): so R, mg., in 2Co 13:2, Gl 5:21, 1Ts 4:6 (cf. προλέγω; but see supr., and cf. M, Th., 38).†
(AS)

G4281.def:
προ-έρχομαι
[in LXX: Gn 33:3, 14 R (עָבַר), Jdth.2:19, Sir.35:10 (Sir.32:10) al ;]
__1. to go forward, go on, advance: before μικρόν, Mt 26:39 and Mc 14:35 (WH, mg., προσελθών): ῥύμην μίαν (cf. Plat., Rep., i, 328e), At 12:10.
__2. Of relative position, to go before, precede: with genitive (cl.; Jth, l.with); with accusative of person(s) (not cl.), Lc 22:47 (with genitive, Rec.); before ἐνώπιον, Lc 1:17 (cf. Gn 33:3).
__3. Of time, to go before or in advance: At 20:5, 13 (WH, mg., R, mg.), 2Co 9:5; with accusative of person(s) (= cl. φθάνω), Mc 6:33.†
(AS)

G4282.def:
προ-ετοιμάζω
[in LXX: Is 28:24 B, Wis.9:8 * ;]
to prepare before: with accusative of thing(s), Rm 9:23 (οἱς for ἅ by attraction), Ef 2:10.†
(AS)

G4284.def:
προ-έχω
[in LXX: Jó 27:6 A (חָזַק hi.) * ;]
__1. Trans., to hold before; mid., to hold something before oneself (Hdt.), hence, metaphorically, to excuse oneself: Rm 3:9, R, mg. (but see Field, Notes, 152 f.; Lft., Notes, 266 f.; ICC and Vau., in l).
__2. Intrans.
__(a) to project;
__(b) in running, to have the start, hence, metaphorically, to excel: pass., Ro, l.with, R, txt. (see reff. supr.).†
(AS)

G4285.def:
προ-ηγέσμαι
[in LXX: Dt 20:9 (בְּרוֹשׁ), Pv 17:14 (פָּנִים), 2Ma.4:40, al. ;]
__1. to go before as leader (in cl., with genitive, dative): Rm 12:10 (Chrys., Vg., al.; see ICC, in l).
__2. In a sense not elsewhere found, ἀλλήλους προηγούμενοι = ἀ. ἡγούμενοι ὑπερέχοντας: Ro, l.with (ICC, cf. 1Ts 5:13, Fp 2:3 and EV "preferring").†
(AS)

G4286.def:
πρό-θεσις, -εως, ἡ
[in LXX: Êx 40:4, 23 (עֵרֶךְ), 1Cr 9:32, al. (מַעֲרֶכֶת), 2Cr 4:19 (פָּנִים), 1Ma.1:22, 2Ma.3:8, al. ;]
__1. a setting forth (Plat., Plut., al.): οἱ ἄρτοι τῆς π. (cf. LXX, ll. with, elsewhere ἄρτοι ἐνώπιοι, Êx 25:29; οἱ ἄ. τοῦ προσώπου, Ne 10:33), Mt 12:4, Mc 2:26, Lc 6:4; ἡ π. τῶν ἄρτων, Hb 9:2.
__2. a purpose (Mist., Polyb., al.; 2Mac, l.with): At 11:23 27:13, Rm 8:28 9:11, Ef 1:11 3:11, 2Tm 1:9 3:10.†
(AS)

G4287.def:
προ-θέσμιος, -α, -ον
[in Sm.: Jó 28:3, Dn 9:26 * ;]
appointed before­hand. In Attic law, as subst. (so always in cl.), ἡ π. (sc. ἡμέρα), a day appointed beforehand, a previously appointed time: Gl 4:2.†
(AS)

G4288.def:
προθυμία, -ας, ἡ
(πρόθυμος), [in LXX: Sir.45:23 * ;]
eagerness, willingness, readiness: At 17:11, 2Co 8:11-12 8:19 9:2.†
(AS)

G4289.def:
πρόθυμος, -ον
[in LXX: 1Cr 28:21, 2Cr 29:31 (נָדִיב), Hc 1:8 (חוּשׁ), al. ;]
willing, ready: Mt 26:41, Mc 14:38; neut., τὸ π. = ἡ προθυμία (Thuc., al., 3Ma.5:26), οὕτως τὸ κατ᾽ ἐμὲ (= cl. τὸ ἐμὸν) π., Rm 1:15 (but see ICC, in l).†
(AS)

G4290.def:
προθύμως
[in LXX: 2Cr 29:34 (יָשָׁר לֵבָב), Tob.7:8, al. ;]
eagerly, readily, with a ready mind: 1Pe 5:2.†
(AS)

G4291.def:
προ-ΐστημι
[in LXX: 2Rs 13:17, Pv 23:5 26:17, Is 43:24, Am 6:10 (no proper Heb. equiv.), Dan LXX Bel 1:7, 1Ma.5:19, 4Ma.11:27 * ;]
__1. trans. in fut., 1 aor., and mid. 1 aor., to put before, set over (Plat., al.).
__2. Intrans., in pf., plpf., 2 aor. and mid. Pres. and impf.;
__(a) to preside, rule, govern: Rm 12:8, 1Tm 5:17; with genitive, 1Ts 5:12, 1Tm 3:4-5 3:12;
__(b) to direct, maintain: with genitive of thing(s), καλῶν ἔργων, Tt 3:8, 14 (on R, mg., profess honest occupations, see CGT, in l; Field, Notes, 223 f.).†
(AS)

G4292.def:
προ-καλέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 2Ma.8:11 A * ;]
to call forth.
Most frequently in mid.,
__(a) to challenge; hence, to provoke: Gl 5:26;
__(b) to invite (2Mac, l.with).†
(AS)

G4293.def:
προ-κατ-αγγέλλω
to announce beforehand: with accusative and inf., At 3:18; before περί, At 7:52.†
(AS)

G4295.def:
πρό-κειμαι
[in LXX: Êx 39:18 (36), Nm 4:7 (פָּנִים), etc. ;]
used as pass. of προτίθημι;
__1. to be set before one, to be set forth: Hb 6:18 12:1-2, Ju 7.
__2. to present oneself, be present: 2Co 8:12 (see Mey., in l).†
(AS)

G4296.def:
προ-κηρύσσω
__1. to proclaim by herald.
__2. Of one who acts as a herald, to proclaim: At 13:24.†
(AS)

G4297.def:
προ-κοπή, -ῆς, ἡ
(προκόπτω), [in LXX: Sir.51:17, 2Ma.8:8 * ;]
progress (prop., on a journey, then generally): Fp 1:12, 25, 1Tm 4:15 (condemned by Atticists, see Rutherford, NPhr., 158).†
(AS)

G4298.def:
προ-κόπτω
[in Sm.: Sl 45:5 * ;]
to cut forward a way, for­ward, advance, in cl. trans. with neut. adj., as οὐδὲν π., τὰ πολλὰ π. In late writers (Polyb., al.), wholly intrans., to advance, progress: of time, Rm 13:12. Metaphorical, Lc 2:52, Gl 1:14, 2Tm 2:16 3:9 3:13.†
(AS)

G4299.def:
πρό-κριμα, -τος, τό
(cl. προκρίνειν, 1. to prefer. 2. to judge beforehand),
pre-judging, prejudice: 1Tm 5:21 (see Cremer, 378).†
(AS)
